entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Forced automatic newline after "if (...)" instruction without parentheses in C# #80203
  • Remove unneeded `#pragma warning suppress CS1998` with .NET 10 #80198
    Next
  • Collection Expression with ref struct types leads to runtime exception #80193
  • Completion inside `with` expression initializers still treats required members specially #80192
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Log project context in which document was found #80202
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Add api to allow customizing options per DiagnosticAnalyzer #80200
    Needs API Review
  • Update System.Text.Json in packages which use 4.12 Roslyn #80197
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Rename 'FixAllProvider' to 'RefactorAllProvider' for refactorings. #80196
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Remove in-memory callbacks controlling deprioritization of diagnostic analyzers. #80194
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Remove unused feature flag #80190
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Move CodeStyle analysis enforcement to .NET 11 #80201
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Avoid loading MEF caches that are clearly bad #80195
    VSCode
  • Make diagnostic id filtering into pure data #80191
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Reduce allocations in InlineHintHelpers.GetDescriptionAsync #80185
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Targeting IFormattable builds a FormattableString too #80187
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Simplify diagnostics api #80189
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Reduce allocations in AssemblySymbol.GetTopLevelTypeByMetadataName #79810
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Remove 'filters' from IDiagService and make it a pure data api. #80177
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80188
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Reference specific MS.Build.Tasks.Core version #80158
    Area-Infrastructure, Next

Updated

  • Only publish to the VS feed for our official build #80009
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Remove CS1998 warning entirely and remove dependent C# code fix providers #80144
    VSCode
  • Remove CompilationPair abstraction in diagnostic analyzer subsystem (with api change) #80141
    Area-Analyzers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Fall back to `dotnet exec` if apphost does not exist #80153
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: DocumentationCommentId and ExtensionGroupingName/ExtensionMarkerName APIs #80164
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Extensions: add SyntaxGenerator support and AssociatedExtensionImplementation API #80170
    Area-IDE, Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Create virtual metadata files for VSCode #79023
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Warn for redundant pattern in `not ... or <redundant>` pattern #75581
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Ensure that refkinds are rewritten for complex methods #79916
    Area-Compilers
  • Runtime-async ref local hoisting #80093
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Break cycle for lambda using field keyword with inferred return type #79995
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Field Keyword
